note: ADR-0006 template-owned path boundary. Ownership is resolved by longest matching prefix; a prefix ending in '/' matches a directory subtree, otherwise it matches an exact file. On a tie, user-owned wins (fail-closed: an upgrade never touches a path it isn't sure the template owns). Conservatively excludes apps/ (portal carries user/plugin pages) and infra/environments/ (per-instance config and secrets) for now; that boundary can widen later. services/api/migrations/versions/ is user-owned even though services/api/ is template-owned: Alembic migration files are an append-only, per-instance chain (each instance accumulates its own, chained by down_revision), so syncing them from the template breaks the instance's revision graph. The migration framework itself (migrations/env.py, script.py.mako) stays template-owned.
